mapper.sql: select id, user_id, ai_service_id, ai_service_key, model_id, search_service_id, search_service_key from user_webui_config
mapper.insert:
insert into user_webui_config
user_id, ai_service_id, ai_service_key, model_id, search_service_id, search_service_key,
#{userId}, #{aiServiceId}, #{aiServiceKey}, #{modelId}, #{searchServiceId}, #{searchServiceKey},
mapper.delete:
delete from user_webui_config where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select su.user_id userId, su.user_name userName, /* ai服务字段*/ ase.id aiServiceId, ase.service_name serviceName, ase.service_url serviceUrl, am.model_name modelName, uwc.ai_service_key aiServiceKey, /* 搜索服务字段*/ ss.id searchServiceId, ss.service_name searchServiceName, ss.service_url searchServiceUrl, ss.search_engine_cx searchEngineCx, uwc.search_service_key searchServiceKey from user_webui_config uwc left join ai_service ase on ase.id = uwc.ai_service_id left join ai_model am on am.id = uwc.model_id left join search_service ss on uwc.search_service_id = ss.id left join sys_user su on su.user_id = uwc.user_id
